# nah_network (Data Source)

Reads a NahCloud network.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nah_network" "app" {
  project = "my-app"
  id      = "NETWORK_ID"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Opaque resource ID.
- `project` (String) Project slug.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Network name.
- `project_id` (String) Opaque owning project ID.
- `region` (String) Network region.
